ValidationRule.description: When the Cash Collateral Card is STP and the Approver Transfer Type field is blank, then CRM will fire this validation
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( ISPICKVAL(cc_Control_Type__c, 'STP'), ISCHANGED(cc_Signature_Verifier_Result__c), ISPICKVAL(cc_Signature_Verifier_Result__c, 'Accept'), Is_Balance_Transfer__c = true, ISBLANK(Text(cc_Approved_Transfer_Type__c)), ($User.LastName <> "Integration"), ISPICKVAL(Type , "Credit Card Cash Collateral Application") )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Please fill in the Approver Transfer Type field for Ila Gulf Air cards.
